title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

title: Building Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us! This information is provided for prospective applicants. Benefits details can be found at the university benefits site.

Job Purpose

The Building Manager ensures the smooth operation of teaching, research and office space, and acts as a liaison between the Chemistry Department, Department of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), and Physical Facilities Management (PFM) team. The candidate must have a strong understanding of building systems and chemistry laboratories. The successful candidate will oversee and participate in needed maintenance and repairs of the building to ensure functional integrity for teaching and research.

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include staff, students and faculty.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serves as the main contact for the Chemistry Department for routine and emergency maintenance and repair requests.
  • Monitor the building condition (particularly the laboratory space) by performing regular inspections, and schedule routine maintenance (e.g., fume hoods, HVAC, and roof). Report maintenance or cleaning needs to the department staff.
  • Assist the department with submission of work orders to PFM as needed and monitor progress.
  • Oversee the work of vendors and contractors by maintaining standing orders and managing professional relationships; and provide building access to outside vendors and contractors.
  • Work closely with faculty and staff to provide solutions to facility-related problems.
  • Design, plan, or assist in renovation/modification projects to meet specific department or research needs or to correct building problems, requiring an understanding of structural design and department needs.
  • Respond to building emergencies, and serve as the primary emergency contact 24 hours a day throughout the year, including semester breaks, weekends, and holidays.
  • Assist faculty, staff and graduate students with shipping, receiving, and moving tasks.
  • Installation of some laboratory equipment, cabinetry, shelving, etc.
  • Communicate with the appropriate Facilities staff when the work order is not completed within a reasonable time frame.
  • Serve as a liaison to Public Safety, PFM, EHS, and other university entities in emergency response situations and for safety-related topics.
  • Supervision of small groups of student workers.

Laboratory Safety

  • Troubleshoot and advise on problems that arise regarding the safety of building or laboratory facilities.
  • Check safety showers and eyewash stations weekly to ensure their working conditions.
  • Remain up to date with University safety training.
  • Act as a department contact for Department of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS).
  • Understand hazardous material safety guidelines per University protocols.
  • Work with EHS on proper handling of hazardous waste materials from teaching and research laboratories.
  • Assist in chemical/solvent deliveries as necessary.
  • Develop and execute response plans for safety, security, and business continuity.

Perform other duties as assigned by the Chemistry Department.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five years of related experience in a variety of trades relevant to general building functions including carpentry, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and mechanical; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Knowledge of building materials and methods.
  • Proven supervisory skills.
  • Abilities to use Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel and Outlook.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to work with faculty members, staff, and students.
  • Valid driver’s license (ability to drive University vehicles).
  • Ability to climb ladders, kneel, reach above the shoulder, stand and/or walk for extended periods of time and may be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in specifying and purchasing parts or equipment.
  • Experience working in chemistry laboratory/research setting.
  • Understanding and minor maintenance of water purification systems, laboratory hoods, and electronic locksets.
  • Ability to engage, connect, and work with diverse student, administrative, and faculty populations and provide a commitment to the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion in an educational setting.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$65,000-$75,000

title: Metering Engineer
description:
This position will support FPSO operations by overseeing and ensuring the integrity of all metering systems. It will involve monitoring system performance, validating data, and providing daily operational support. The role will also act as the Technical Authority for metering, ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory requirements, including ANP and INMETRO standards.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for ensuring that all fluid metering systems at FPSO are performed in accordance with the technical requirements and legal deadlines, meeting the requirements outlined in Joint Resolution ANP / INMETRO 01: 2013 (RTM).
  • Provide technical support daily, in relation to measurement problems in the FPSO.
  • Participate/assist in metering audits.
  • Act as Technical Authority to measurement issues.
  • Verify that FPSO operator’s procedures and manuals are in accordance with current ANP, ISO and other relevant standards for offshore oil and natural gas flow measurement (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Manage and monitor the status of the flow metering systems (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Conduct critical analysis of failure reports, calibrations and periodic maintenance of fiscal, allocation and custody transfer metering systems in accordance with RTM and applicable standards.
  • Verify, validate and submit data (failure reports, flow computer data, well test reports and monthly production report) related to the FPSO metering systems to ANP.
  • Keep updated the measurement points registered in the SFP (ANP production system).
  • Validate offloading measurement reports.
  • Verify the operational history of seal removal and installation.
  • Verify that the FPSO operator is following calibration plans, uncertainty calculations, and required flow computer upgrades.
  • Verify / validate in case of measurement system failure the volume estimate as specified in ANP resolutions.
  • Verify / monitor backups of measurement equipment information, fault history, equipment replacement, and parameter changes.
  • Carry out the planning and control of the sample collection service for chemical analysis, interface with logistics for loading / unloading materials related to the samples, and, if necessary, validate the results of PVT and chromatographic analysis. After validation, monitor the results/inform the need to update the flow computers.
  • Follow up the routines to keep the Metering Management System in operation without non-conformities.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Automation, Petroleum, Production, Chemical Engineering or related.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems.
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE etc.
  • Advanced English (oral and written).

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

Sobre a vaga

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você será responsável pelo suporte técnico prestado aos usuários, pela manutenção e implantação de equipamentos, programas e sistemas, e pelo planejamento e desempenho da área de TI na unidade. Deve solicitar orçamentos quando necessário, e providenciar a aquisição de equipamentos e licenças.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciamento de redes, servidores e ativos:
  • Manter os servidores;
  • Realizar a configuração e instalação de novos equipamentos de rede, assegurando que a documentação da rede esteja atualizada;
  • Monitorar redes, verificando logs e equipamentos físicos;
  • Realizar a inclusão, manutenção e exclusão de usuários no ambiente de rede corporativo;
  • Manter e atualizar a lista/inventário de ativos de TDIC da escola.

Suporte técnico

  • Fornecer apoio técnico aos alunos e colaboradores assegurando o diagnóstico e reparação de problemas técnicos em diversos equipamentos tecnológicos (laptops, projetores, sistemas de informação, servidores etc) de forma que todo o hardware e software funcione corretamente;
  • Preparar equipamentos de TI para utilização;
  • Executar procedimentos de rotina para checar de forma preventiva se equipamentos e soluções estão funcionando como previsto e esperado;
  • Prestar suporte e atendimento a telefonia móvel e VOIP da escola;
  • Manter contatos regulares com as equipes das escolas para verificar preventivamente se as soluções de tecnologia estão funcionando como esperado.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI - Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Rede de Computadores ou afins;
  • Experiência com suporte técnico de TI, sistemas operacionais clientes Windows (Windows server 2012 ou superior), Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, WSUS, File server, Print Server, ativos de rede (impressoras, scanners, WIFI);

Declaração de Salvaguarda

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. title: Senior Project Controls Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline‑specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Project Controls Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the project controls team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project‑driven environment
  • Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software
  • Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance measurement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong critical thinking, problem‑solving, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive‑level reporting
  • Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi‑phase projects
  • Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi‑dimensional models that support real‑time decision‑making
  • Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
  • Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives
  • Provide strategic insights by identifying correlations, anomalies, and emerging trends within large datasets to support proactive project management
  • Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long‑term project planning and risk mitigation
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
  • Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge‑sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data‑driven decision‑making

In this hourly-paid, fully remote contractor role, you will review AI-generated responses and/or generate language content, evaluate reasoning quality and step-by-step problem-solving, and provide expert feedback so outputs are accurate, logical, and clearly explained.   • Ability to rigorously fact-check localized content (units, references, names, dates) using reliable sources and consistent reasoning.
  • Comfort working as an hourly contractor: dependable throughput, clear documentation, and responsiveness across time zones.
  • Previous experience with AI data training / annotation / evaluation is preferred.

title: Brazil - Remote: Team Lead - Digital Twin Platform
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the “Control Room” and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s “Visualizations” and that the “Data Pipelines” are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert' : When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a 'deliver fast' mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.

A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Além da nossa atuação pelo Brasil, com escritório no Rio de janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, temos também filiais nos Estados Unidos, fazendo com que a Radix se consolide cada vez mais como uma empresa global .

Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade?

Como Business Analyst Senior você vai:

  • Principais responsabilidades:
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento da visão de futuro de Transformação Digital do cliente (Refinaria Multinacional), participando de diagnósticos, benchmarks, análises de maturidade e estruturação de recomendações estratégicas.
  • Conduzir levantamentos, análises quantitativas e qualitativas, organizando dados operacionais, financeiros, de tecnologia e processos para fundamentar decisões estratégicas e capturas de valor.
  • Mapear processos atuais, dores, oportunidades e alavancas de valor, traduzindo achados em insights estruturados, hipóteses e recomendações de evolução.
  • Apoiar a elaboração do roadmap de transformação digital, incluindo priorização de iniciativas, avaliação de impactos, dependências e estimativas de esforço.
  • Construir apresentações executivas claras e orientadas a storytelling, consolidando análises em materiais que suportem comitês, lideranças e workshops de decisão.
  • Suportar a criação e manutenção dos indicadores do programa, garantindo visibilidade sobre progresso, riscos, lições aprendidas e resultados capturados ao longo dos 3 anos de execução.
  • Acompanhar rituais de governança, registrando decisões, evoluções e riscos, além de apoiar a comunicação estruturada com stakeholders internos do cliente.
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento do portfólio de iniciativas, monitorando aderência à visão estratégica, prazos, qualidade, orçamento e potenciais desvios.
  • Preparar análises estratégicas e estudos específicos sob demanda, como business cases, avaliação de tecnologias emergentes e benchmarks de mercado.
  • Contribuir para a preparação de propostas, modelagem de esforços e identificação de novas oportunidades de expansão junto ao cliente.

Para essa vaga, você deve ter:

  • Experiência prévia como analista de consultoria ou em projetos de transformação digital, planejamento estratégico, PMO ou inovação.
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas, com domínio de estruturação de problemas, análise de dados, modelagem e síntese.
  • Capacidade de organizar informações complexas e transformá-las em narrativas executivas claras, estruturadas e orientadas à ação.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos, métricas de acompanhamento, ferramentas de planejamento e indicadores de performance.
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, entrevistas com stakeholders, facilitação e mapeamento de processos.
  • Proatividade para antecipar riscos, mobilizar informações e apoiar decisões críticas com base em análises sólidas.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, capacidade de relacionamento com diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos.
  • Inglês avançado para lidar com cliente global.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em indústria de óleo & gás, energia ou química, especialmente em operações de refino.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de Transformação Digital, governança de portfólio e modelagem de roadmap.
  • Experiência prévia com programas de 3+ anos, PMO estratégico ou iniciativas de larga escala.
  • Familiaridade com análises financeiras, modelagem de business case e cálculos de criação/captura de valor.
  • Vivência com tecnologias digitais aplicadas a operações industriais: AI/ML, advanced analytics, digital twins, LIMS, MES, historiadores, plataformas cloud, etc.
  • Certificações ou conhecimentos em: Scrum/Agile, Lean, OKR, Design Thinking, Gestão de Portfólio, Power BI / Tableau.
  • Experiência com condução de workshops, sprints estratégicas ou facilitação de grupos.

Benefícios:

  • Parceria com empresa de coworkings no Brasil
  • Programa de Qualidade de Vida e Bem-Estar
  • Médico consultor para acompanhamento de radixers
  • Planos de incentivos

A Radix está sempre no topo das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar porque:

  • Temos profissionais comprometidos, dedicados, curiosos e inovadores.
  • O espírito de equipe é a nossa maior força. Trabalhamos de forma cooperativa e sabemos que estamos juntos, remando na mesma direção.
  • Temos um ambiente diverso, que valoriza equidade e inclusão.
  • Nossa jornada de trabalho é flexível e em quase todos os projetos é possível trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar e o cuidado com as nossas pessoas, com programas de apoio à saúde mental, psiquiatra e médico consultor disponíveis.

Há 15 anos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar no Rio, no Brasil e em Tecnologia... Prazer, Radix.

title: Game Penetration Tester
description:
Cyrex, a Magic Media company, is a media and tech start-up powered by creativity and innovation. We work with leading developers and publishers in the games industry, providing support and solutions designed around individual needs and carried out by global experts.

We produce high-quality results by constantly staying at the forefront of modern technology and cutting-edge processes and practices. The best of our team are known for their strong initiative, not just in taking care of their day-to-day responsibilities but in helping identify ways to build, grow, and do more in their work.

We’re currently looking for adynamic addition tothe team tohelp work onexciting cybersecurity and development projects for the video games industry. The ideal candidate will work with cross-functional teams todevelop critical products and services for our clients and offer excellent technical support toour teams. Ifyou’re anenthusiastic, motivated, and lateral thinker, our team iswaiting tomeet you!

This is a full-time position. The role requires strong low-level technical skills, such as C++ programming, working with network protocols, or reverse engineering. If your experience is mainly in web hacking, you should instead apply for the on-demand penetration testing position, which focuses more on web security.

Responsibilities

  • Perform penetration tests on PC, mobile, and console games.
  • Reverse engineer game binaries and network protocols to identify vulnerabilities.
  • Bypass client-side protections (SSL pinning, anti-cheat, packing/obfuscation).
  • Develop and maintain internal tools and PoCs (C++, Python).
  • 5+ years in penetration testing, reverse engineering or security research.
  • Strong modern C++ and Python experience.
  • Networking: TCP/UDP fundamentals (fragmentation, sequencing, multiplexing) and protocol design/mapping. Experience with Wireshark, mitmproxy and Scapy.
  • Data/crypto basics: endianness, checksums, hashing, encoding, encryption/signing, bitmasks.
  • Serialization: binary formats and var-length encodings.
  • Binary exploitation (practical): crash triage, UAF/OOB/heap/stack, info leaks, ROP/JOP.
  • Minimal RE capability: read disassembly when needed; use IDA/Ghidra and x64dbg/WinDbg/LLDB to support testing (deep reversing not required).
  • Basic web hacking knowledge.

Working knowledge of

  • Unreal Engine (UE4/UE5, UE4SS), Unity, dnSpy, il2cpp.
  • An opportunity to hone and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of gaming projects
  • The chance to work closely with a team of like-minded creative professionals in a fast-paced, multicultural environment on a variety of gaming projects
  • A competitive salary
  • Ongoing training and professional self-improvement opportunities

If this sounds interesting to you and you’d like to be at the forefront of cybersecurity, we’d love hear from you.

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Gerente de Manutenção
description:
Descrição da empresa

NOSSA MARCA

Surgindo como uma marca pioneira de hospitalidade de luxo francesa em 1964, o Sofitel traz o espírito francês e inspira encontros genuínos e memoráveis nos destinos mais desejados do mundo

Combinando de forma harmoniosa a cultura local com a energia francesa pela vida, através de um savoir-faire excepcional e serviço generoso, o Sofitel é para viajantes de espírito livre e apreciadores das artes e da cultura que valorizam um sentido refinado e discreto de luxo moderno.

SOFITEL IPANEMA

Sofitel, referência global em hospitalidade de luxo francesa, anuncia a transformação do Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema em seu primeiro hotel flagship no Brasil, com abertura prevista para o final de 2026.

Localizado na Praia de Ipanema, o hotel contará com 172 apartamentos e representará a visão contemporânea da marca sobre luxo, serviço e experiência.

Faça partelo do time de talentos que dará vida a este novo ícone da hotelaria de luxo no Brasil.

Descrição da vaga

O Gerente de Manutenção atuará como o engenheiro responsável pelo hotel, liderando a equipe de manutenção e prestadores de serviços. Essa posição hands‑on garante a operação eficiente do departamento, mantendo os mais altos padrões de qualidade, segurança e excelência.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Gerenciar e liderar a equipe de Manutenção, coordenando tarefas diárias de técnicos, analistas, coordenadores e prestadores de serviços externos;
  • Atuar ativamente na pré‑abertura do hotel, assegurando que todos os sistemas, operações e padrões de qualidade estejam prontos para inauguração;
  • Planejar, supervisionar e executar manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos sistemas elétricos, hidráulicos, de climatização e estrutura civil;
  • Garantir segurança operacional, continuidade das atividades e conformidade regulatória do hotel;
  • Coordenar obras e reformas junto ao time de Projetos, assegurando execução dentro do prazo, orçamento e padrões de qualidade;
  • Implementar e gerenciar sistemas de qualidade, requisição de manutenção (chamados) e controle de pedidos em todas as áreas do hotel;
  • Registrar e analisar consumo de utilidades e sistemas do hotel, reportando os resultados;
  • Contribuir com as normas de Segurança do Trabalho e Sustentabilidade, inspecionando áreas e tomando ações corretivas junto ao time, quando necessário;
  • Atuar ativamente para gerar um impacto positivo do hotel no meio ambiente, implementando iniciativas sustentáveis que promovam a economia de água e energia, garantindo simultaneamente a excelência do serviço e o conforto dos hóspedes;
  • Propor de forma proativa soluções e investimentos necessários para reduzir o consumo de água e geração de resíduos do hotel.

Qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia (obrigatório);
  • Pós‑graduação em Engenharia de Manutenção, Facilities, Gestão de Operações/Projetos;
  • Experiência sólida em liderança em manutenção, preferencialmente em hotelaria de luxo;
  • Vivência em pré‑abertura de hotéis ou resorts de alto padrão;
  • Conhecimento sólido em manutenção predial, sistemas prediais, gestão de obras e fornecedores;
  • Experiência com sistemas e softwares de manutenção;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, liderança e organização;
  • Inglês fluente / Francês será um diferencial;
  • Responsabilidade, confiabilidade e senso de urgência.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from 'Bronze' (Raw) to 'Silver' (Cleaned) and 'Gold' (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .
  • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don\u2019t just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Job description

A área de engenharia de dados é deve garantir que a organização tenha acesso a dados confiáveis e organizados, possibilitando a criação de insights e a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais. Ser um agente de transformação, construindo uma plataforma escalável e resiliente, democratizar o acesso aos dados e impulsionar uma cultura orientada por dados. Missão da Vaga: Projetar, construir e manter pipelines robustos de dados, garantindo que as informações fluam de maneira eficiente e segura. Garantir a disponibilidade, qualidade e governança dos dados. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders e time visando promover melhores práticas na manipulação, análise de grandes volumes de dados otimização de processos.

Main responsibilities

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis para ingestão, processamento e transformação de grandes volumes de dados. Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados para sistemas analíticos.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de armazenamento, incluindo data lakes e data warehouses, em ambientes em nuvem.
  • Garantir a integridade, qualidade e governança dos dados, aplicando boas práticas de gerenciamento e segurança e FINOPS.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócio e oferecer soluções orientadas por dados.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, bases de dados e soluções de integração.
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização de arquitetura de dados, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e frameworks modernos.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência com engenharia de dados ou funções similares.
  • Experiência comprovada com plataformas de data viz (tableau, power bi e/ou looker).
  • Histórico de liderança ou participação ativa em projetos complexos de integração e migração para nuvem.
  • Cloud Computing;
  • Experiência em GCP e seus serviços, BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Function, KMS, Secret Manager, DataStream, Vertex AI e GitHub;
  • Experiência em Azure e seus serviços, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics e Azure Data Lake Storage;
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e Pyspark (usado para scripts e automação) e SQL (para manipulação e consulta de dados).
  • ETL/ELT: Experiência na construção de pipelines de ETL/ELT para ingestão e transformação de dados.
  • Data Lakes: Conhecimento de arquiteturas de Data Lake, armazenamento e otimização de dados (ex.: Delta Lake);
  • DevOps: Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DataOps para automação de deploys e monitoramento de fluxos de dados;
  • Segurança e Governança: Entendimento de práticas de segurança em nuvem, criptografia de dados e implementação de políticas de governança;
  • Orquestração de Dados: Uso de ferramentas como Azure Data Factory e/ou Synapse e/ou Airflow/composer para integração e movimentação de dados.
  • Desempenho e Otimização: Experiência em técnicas para melhorar a performance de pipelines de dados e consultas em ambientes distribuídos e não distribuídos.
  • APIs: Conhecimento em extração de dados via APIs RESTful.

Diferenciais: Certificações de engenharia de dados nas plataformas GCP e/ou Azure (Professional Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer Associate).

Competências Necessárias

Técnicas:

  • Capacidade de projetar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e DevOps para integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Forte habilidade de solucionar problemas complexos de dados com eficiência e criatividade.

Comportamentais:

  • Pensamento analítico e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação para traduzir necessidades técnicas e de negócio.
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência para atender demandas críticas.
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e liderança colaborativa.
  • Compromisso com a aprendizagem contínua e atualização tecnológica.

Additional information

  • Separar os materiais necessários e auxiliar os Médicos ou Enfermeiros nos procedimentos realizados, tais como punções venosas profundas, punções arteriais médias, intubações, entre outras, e providenciar o descarte dos materiais utilizados.
  • Cumprir os protocolos de assistência criados pela Unidade, aplicando todas as medidas preventivas especificadas, visando garantir a segurança do paciente.
  • Conferir e repor o Carro e Maleta de Parada Cardiorrespiratória após a utilização em situações emergenciais, a fim de garantir sua prontidão para novas situações.
  • Prestar vigilância intensiva aos pacientes sob cuidado, notificando imediatamente aos enfermeiros e registrando na evolução do balanço hídrico qualquer intercorrência, para fins de controle.
  • Cumprir as orientações definidas em prescrição médica, para preparo dos pacientes para realização de exames e/ou cirurgias, tais como manutenção de jejum e preparo de cólon, entre outros, a fim de garantir a continuidade do tratamento.
  • Observar previsões de altas e possíveis transferências, com objetivo de priorizar os cuidados, agilizando o processo.
  • Instalar no paciente os equipamentos de monitorização, como bombas infusoras e monitores cardíacos, conforme orientação médica.
  • Preparar corpo do paciente nos casos de óbito, a fim de encaminhá-lo ao Morgue.
  • Realizar a aplicação de compressas quentes e frias, conforme prescrição médica, assegurando a integridade cutânea do paciente.
  • Devolver medicações e materiais do cliente em caso de altas, transferências, óbitos ou em caso de modificações de prescrição, todos devidamente identificados com etiqueta do cliente.
  • Providenciar a devolução dos medicamentos e materiais não utilizados pelos pacientes, fazendo lançamento através do Sistema Phostos, garantindo a confirmação do processo.
  • Checar e rubricar todos os medicamentos prescritos e administrados, lançando no balanço hídrico o horário de início de dieta, transporte de soluções, infusões, medicações SOS e ACM, bem como valor de glicemia, diurese e eliminações, controlando o balanço hídrico com rigor.

Job description

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SP vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Profissional responsável por desenvolver intervenções psicomotoras, promovendo o desenvolvimento global da criança, com foco nas funções cognitivas, motoras e emocionais. Atuará de forma integrada à equipe multiprofissional dentro do CEDTEA.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação na área da saúde ou educação;

  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.

Sobre a MAG

Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo.

Job description

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator
description:
Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimization by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Planning & Operational Readiness

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.

Operational Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.

Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure

  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution

  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.

Team & Contractor Coordination

  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

YOUR PROFILE

THE POSITION

The Cleaning and Waste Management Manager, reporting to both FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager, will be a key member of the FIFA27 team. This role involves close coordination with key stakeholders to meet operational, environmental, and service quality standards.

The position is responsible for developing, coordinating implementation, and overseeing sustainable cleaning and waste management strategies and operations from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This includes leading upstream and downstream waste management and ensuring a seamless, high-quality tournament experience in line with FIFA’s and regional sustainability standards.

The ideal candidate will combine event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management expertise with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

  • Conduct site visits to validate operational readiness, ensuring feasibility, quality, and compliance with operational needs.

  • Provide regular updates to the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager on key milestones, issues, and recommendations.

YOUR PROFILE

About The Role

We are looking for a highly technical Paid Search & YouTube Manager who thrives on intent capture, granular data analysis, and scientific rigor. In this role, you will be instrumental in transitioning our SEM and YouTube operations in-house, taking ownership of these critical high-intent channels to help us scale.

You will work directly with the Director of Paid Media to manage, execute, and optimize campaigns primarily on Google (Search & YouTube) and Microsoft (Bing). This role requires an individual who embodies "curiosity"—you never accept "that’s just the way it is" or rely solely on automated bidding strategies without oversight. Instead, you dive deep into the Search Query Reports to understand the "why" behind performance. You will be expected to work transparently, sharing work queues and mid-stream insights to ensure alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Campaign Execution: Take end-to-end ownership of campaign setup, management, and optimization across Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Discovery/Demand Gen) and Microsoft Ads. You will lead the transition of these responsibilities from our current agency partners.

  • Master Intent & Keywords: Meticulously manage keyword strategy. You will move beyond simple broad match reliance to build robust negative keyword lists, structure high-intent ad groups, and maximize Quality Score to improve efficiency.

  • Drive YouTube Performance: Treat YouTube as a direct-response performance channel. You will collaborate with the creative team to iterate on video hooks, pacing, and CTAs based on retention rates and conversion data, not just vanity view metrics.

  • Scientific A/B Testing: Rigorous A/B testing of headlines, descriptions, and extensions, and landing pages.

  • Master Attribution: Utilize internal analytics and multi-touch attribution (MTA) tools alongside platform data to triangulate performance.

  • Analyze & Iterate: Assist in the set-up and evaluation geo holdout tests to prove incrementality.

  • Work Transparently: Maintain visible work queues and rigorous reporting standards. You will prepare data for weekly paid media performance reviews to discuss budget shifts, CPA targets, and anomalies.

Qualifications

  • Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising is non-negotiable. You must have a track record of scaling direct-response accounts in a D2C environment.

  • Demand Gen / YouTube Experience: Proven experience managing YouTube for conversions (VAC/Demand Gen), not just brand awareness. You understand how to buy YouTube traffic that converts.

  • Tech Stack: Proficiency with 1st party analytics tools is essential (GA4, Looker, Tableau or the like). Preferred experience with (or similar tools to) MTA platforms (Northbeam, Triple Whale), and experience implementing tracking pixels (GTM).

  • Resourcefulness: You are scrappy. You use the tools in front of you to prove value and are willing to track down the information you need rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

  • Data-Driven Mindset: You base your decisions on numbers, ROAS/CAC targets, and data, not assumptions.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience in the Health & Wellness, Telehealth, or Biohacking space.
  • Proven success utilizing Google Scripts or automated rules to streamline optimizations.
  • Experience using AI tools (Claude, GoMarble, Gemini) for platform strategy and analysis.

World-Class Benefits

  • Exposure to top-tier leadership and a meritocratic culture where the best ideas win regardless of title.

title: Brazil - Remote: Team Lead - Digital Twin Platform
description:
Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real‑time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi‑agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: Drive cross‑boundary architectural decisions. Decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. Review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On‑Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high‑level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade‑offs across the entire stack:

  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time‑Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands‑on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies.
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy‑focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect‑Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full‑Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

description:
Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Hunter Sênior| Supply Chain

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um profissional para garantir o cumprimento das metas através da comercialização de produtos e serviços TOTVS com um processo que permita buscar um suspect, compreender suas necessidades, apresentar produtos e serviços, gerar oportunidades, propor, adequar, vender e entregar soluções, sempre mantendo um contínuo relacionamento técnico e empresarial.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir sua carteira de clientes e construir um relacionamento visando rentabilizar, blindar e elevar o nível de satisfação da base TOTVS em relação às responsabilidades do AR nos indicadores de NPS (Farmer);
  • Prospectar novos negócios na base instalada e/ou em novos clientes, visando ampliar Market Share TOTVS (Hunter);
  • Planejar e executar o plano tático alinhado ao planejamento estratégico da DRG e resultados de vendas no segmento/região de atuação;
  • Ser especialista e liderar o assunto no seu negócio, sendo capaz de estabelecer discursos e formas de atuação altamente adequadas ao perfil de cada cliente/prospect/segmento;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas individuais e metas de venda do time do Comercial em que estiver atuando, de acordo com a estratégia da TOTVS;
  • Visitar e assistir a base instalada e os novos clientes, garantindo sempre a excelência do atendimento TOTVS e buscando recorrentemente novos negócios;
  • Atender e se relacionar com o mercado e com a base instalada, através de visitas, reuniões, contatos telefônicos e e-mails;
  • Planejar, executar e liderar o processo de vendas de um produto ou serviço TOTVS ao mercado;
  • Levantar e analisar as informações do negócio, compilar e montar um plano de trabalho apoiado pela metodologia de vendas TOTVS;
  • Registrar no CRM e comunicar a área de Estratégia Comercial/Operações e Segmentos, informações relevantes sobre mercado/carteira;
  • Atuar como facilitador para a solução das demandas dos clientes e prospects;
  • Realizar a interface com as áreas internas da TOTVS;
  • Entregar e acompanhar a entrega dos produtos e/ou serviços TOTVS, garantindo que os acordos sejam cumpridos e os objetivos atendidos;
  • Realizar pós-venda com o objetivo de garantir o atendimento e gerar novas oportunidades (Cross Sell e Up Sell);
  • Mentorar profissionais do AR com o objetivo de compartilhar conhecimento e colaborar para o desenvolvimento da equipe;
  • Ser referência técnica e comercial no seu segmento de atuação;
  • Exercer liderança informal na equipe, apoiando diretamente a gestão formal da empresa;
  • Atuar como multiplicador de conhecimento e auxiliar no desenvolvimento de executivos com alto nível de performance, atuando como buddy para novos TOTVERs;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva em abordagens comerciais por meio de soluções segmentadas conforme área de atuação, potencializando a percepção de valor pelo cliente/prospect sobre os produtos e serviços TOTVS.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Pós Graduação, Especialização ou MBA completo;
  • Vivência com vendas B2B de software de tecnologia e ERP;
  • Perfil Hunter, de prospecção de novos negócios;
  • Familiaridade com segmento de Supply Chain.
  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada TOTVER;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para TOTVERS;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para TOTVERS e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

Sobre a empresa

Como empresa líder em tecnologia somos um universo de pessoas inconformadas, movidas por inovação, autonomia, aprendizado e performance. Juntos e juntas, criamos oportunidades, transformamos futuros e compartilhamos conhecimento. Aqui o seu desenvolvimento profissional acontece em um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e energizante. De gente pra gente! Buscamos o crescimento sustentável. E usamos dados e IA para impulsionar resultados mais inteligentes e eficientes para os nossos clientes. Vem com a gente inovar e construir o futuro da tecnologia. #VemPraTOTVS #SomosTOTVS
