title: Brazil - RJ - Rio de Janeiro: Tech Lead
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR

Dover Fueling Solutions ("DFS"), uma empresa Dover (NYSE: DOV) composta pelos negócios ClearView, Fairbanks, ProGauge, Tokheim, Wayne Fueling Systems e OPW's Fuel Management Systems, oferece equipamentos avançados de abastecimento de combustíveis, sistemas eletrônicos e pagamento, medição automática de tanques e soluções de gerenciamento de estoque de líquidos para clientes em todo o mundo. Sediada em Austin, Texas, a DFS tem uma presença global significativa, incluindo instalações nos EUA, Reino Unido, Holanda, Suécia, França, Índia, China e Brasil. Para obter mais informações, visite

Atuar como parceiro estratégico da gestão industrial, sendo responsável por análises aprofundadas de custos de produção, performance operacional e gestão de estoques, apoiando a tomada de decisão por meio de dados, indicadores e análises críticas, com foco em eficiência, produtividade, rentabilidade e capital de giro.

DESCRIÇÃO DETALHADA:

Principais responsabilidades

  • Analisar custos industriais (fixos e variáveis) com foco em eficiência operacional e produtividade.
  • Monitorar e explicar variações entre custo orçado, padrão e realizado, identificando causas raiz.
  • Avaliar impactos de volume, mix, eficiência, perdas, refugos e utilização de capacidade nos custos.
  • Desenvolver análises de custo por produto / família.
  • Analisar e acompanhar estoques de matérias-primas, WIP e produtos acabados.
  • Monitorar indicadores como giro, cobertura, obsolescência, perdas e acuracidade.
  • Apoiar a definição e acompanhamento de políticas de estoque e capital de giro.
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar KPIs industriais (custo por unidade, OEE, produtividade, custo de conversão).
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards (Excel / Power BI).
  • Apoiar análises de viabilidade econômica de novos produtos, processos e investimentos.
  • Atuar de forma próxima às áreas Industrial, PCP, Supply Chain, Compras e Logística.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes industriais complexos ou multinacionais.
  • Vivência com projetos de redução de custos e otimização de estoques.

Perfil comportamental

  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão de negócio.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva.
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso de dono.
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambiente multifuncional.

FORMAÇÃO

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em custos industriais, performance operacional e/ou FP&A industrial.
  • Vivência com análise de custos de produção e gestão de estoques.
  • Excel avançado e conhecimento em Power BI.
  • Experiência com ERP (SAP, Oracle, JDE, Totvs ou similares).
  • Inglês intermediário

Todos os candidatos qualificados receberão consideração pelo emprego sem discriminação com base na raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, origem nacional, deficiência, idade, informação genética, ou quaisquer outros fatores proibidos por lei.

title: Senior Global Talent Sourcer
description:
Senior Global Talent Sourcer

About Nu

Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 117 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Learn more:

About the team

The sourcing team is the engine behind Nu’s leadership growth. We are responsible for identifying and engaging the architects of our future. Our focus is on Executive (C-level, VP, Director) and Enterprise/Corporate functions (Finance, Legal, People, Compliance, and Business Development), driving efficiency through:

  • Executive Market Intelligence: Mapping the global landscape of leadership talent and understanding the movement of high-level executives across the FinTech and Enterprise sectors.
  • High-Touch Talent Analytics: Analyzing the quality and conversion of executive pipelines, ensuring we engage the right leaders for Nu’s long-term global strategy.
  • Strategic Market Mapping: Identifying specialized "hunting grounds" for corporate excellence and creating exclusive, diverse talent pools of high-impact passive candidates.

In this position, you will:

  • Target Executive Talent: Identify, map, and engage senior leaders and specialized corporate professionals capable of navigating complex, regulated global environments.
  • Advise Senior Stakeholders: Act as a strategic partner to hiring managers, providing data-driven insights to influence hiring decisions and organizational design.
  • Master Personalized Outreach: Craft bespoke, highly professional engagement strategies for passive executive talent, ensuring a premium candidate experience from the first touchpoint.
  • Execute Global Mappings: Build robust market maps and cluster data on competitors and peer companies to identify top-tier talent in Finance, Legal, Operations, and other Enterprise functions.
  • Manage Complexity: Balance the urgency of corporate needs with the discretion and long-term relationship-building required for executive-level recruitment.
  • Drive Diversity at the Top: Proactively build diverse leadership pipelines, ensuring Nu’s executive layer reflects the diversity of our global customer base.

Requirements:

  • Proven Experience: Solid background in Executive Search or Corporate/Enterprise Sourcing (Finance, Legal, G&A, or Business functions) on a global scale.
  • Executive Presence: Exceptional ability to communicate and build rapport with high-level stakeholders and C-suite candidates.
  • Analytical Rigor: Proficiency in using market data, compensation trends, and talent mapping tools to build autonomous strategies for leadership pipelines.
  • Discretion & Influence: Ability to handle confidential information and influence senior decision-makers in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Fluent English: Essential for global collaboration and executive engagement across regions.

Why Nubank?

  • Purpose-driven work that impacts millions of people.
  • Collaborative and inclusive remote culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Learning and development support to grow your career.
  • Opportunity to help shape the future of financial services.
  • Health, dental and life insurance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check moreinformation here.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we’re building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That’s why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

title: Sales Quality Jr Manager
description:
Company Overview

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um pouco mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

You will join, as an individual contributor, the newly established Commercial Quality team within our Commercial Enablement structure at 99Food, an operation committed to scaling high-performance field sales with the right skills, consistency, and impact. Your mission is to act as the "quality gatekeeper", monitoring everything that may go wrong in the sales operation, from skill execution to system usage and process adherence, and ensuring rapid diagnosis and correction. This role combines on-the-ground observation, data-driven auditing, and strategic feedback, driving immediate action and long-term improvement in our sales engine.

Role Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and own a comprehensive Sales Quality framework, including deep-dive audits, scorecards (technical, behavioral, process, system use), and structured feedback mechanisms.
  • Conduct audits across the commercial journey, observing field visits, CRM/system logs, demos, emails, and adherence to playbooks, to identify deviations and opportunities.
  • Manage with the team, frequent field visits alongside Business Developers to observe live execution, assess coaching needs, and validate actual vs. documented behavior.
  • Analyze usage patterns in CRMs and other commercial tools to detect gaps, underutilization, or misuse, feeding insights back into training, KB, and process improvement.
  • Act as a guardian of excellence: monitor compliance with playbooks, process flow, KB, and use of tools, and ensure alignment for every BD interaction.
  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Operations, and Tech teams to translate QA findings into enhancements, improving Knowledge Base, training modules, workflows, and system improvements.
  • Produce recurring reports on QA insights, emerging gaps, trends, and prioritized recommendations for rapid corrective action and strategic evolution.
  • Coach and mentor QA Specialists, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, consistency, and data-based quality execution.
  • Advocate for operational, process, and systemic improvements with a hypothesis-driven mindset, strong alignment with broader Quality Control principles.

Role Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5–7 years of experience in quality management, process auditing, Sales QA, especially in field sales, tech, or scaling environments.
  • Proven ability to design robust QA frameworks, including scorecards, performance grids, audit routines, and escalation pathways.
  • High analytical capacity: you convert both quantitative data (CRM, metrics, dashboards) and qualitative observations (field, demos) into actionable insights.

Job Overview

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables

  • Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
  • Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
  • Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables

  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID’s
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

The Uniforms Senior Manager is responsible for the planning and operational delivery of the corporate FIFA27 Business Casual uniform as well as the FWWC2027 Tournament Dedicated and FIFA Formal uniform programmes in line with the overall FIFA Uniform Strategy and the approved usage and entitlement matrix.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for full project management and implementation of the FWWC2027 uniform programme including issuance operations that support both workforce and volunteers
  • Ensure all FIFA27 workforce have uniform according to the entitlement and usage matrix
  • Effectively collaborate with key FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 stakeholders including Workforce Planning, Volunteer Management, Host City Management, Logistics, Accreditation and Partnership Rights Delivery
  • Create strategy, process and flows for the full project plan for FWWC2027 uniform programme capturing risks and mitigations throughout

  • Manage relationships with external uniform suppliers that may be required, ensuring compliance in line with Framework Agreement and enforcing contractual obligations

  • Manage stock levels and keep up-to-date records of each uniform item during pre-tournament (e.g. Business Casual uniform/ formal items that may be required for side events) and tournament time.
  • Communicate the agreed FIFA27 Uniform Guidelines and Usage Policy at each FIFA tournament and event
  • Ensure the uniform guidelines are upheld and enforced across all client groups including FIFA Formal Uniform eligibility
  • Plan uniform distribution to all related FWW2027 additional events, e.g. Final Draw
  • Work with relevant FIFA27 stakeholders to agree and provide guidelines to Suppliers who are not entitled to Tournament Dedicated Uniforms
  • Other duties as necessary to ensure the smooth running of the FWWC2027 Uniform operations.

title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly overseeing the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Se você busca um lugar onde sua criatividade é valorizada, suas ideias têm impacto e o crescimento profissional é uma realidade, a Limppano é o lugar certo para você. title: Project Engineer Integrity
description:
Overview

The Project Engineer Integrity will support offshore projects and life-extension activities by providing practical marine and structural engineering input. The role focuses on project execution, offshore readiness, integrity assessments, inspections, repairs, and MOC support, ensuring safe and compliant implementation of structural and marine modifications.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in concept selection, FEED, detailed design and execution of offshore brownfield and life-extension projects.
  • Provide marine and structural engineering input for FPSOs and other offshore structures.
  • Translate engineering deliverables into offshore execution scopes, including workpacks, methodologies, inspection strategies, and lifting/installation philosophies.
  • Interface with class societies, marine warranty surveyors, and inspection vendors on structural and marine matters.
  • Review, approve or coordinate structural analysis reports, integrity assessments, repair plans, reinforcement strategies and life-extension studies.
  • Support offshore campaigns involving inspections, repairs, modifications, installations or remediation works.
  • Work closely with marine, construction, operations, and HSE teams to ensure offshore readiness and safe execution.
  • Provide engineering support for structural integrity, reassessment, and life-extension of offshore assets.
  • Support Management of Change (MOC) processes related to structural and marine modifications.
  • Review inspection findings and define required repair, reinforcement or mitigation actions.
  • Support troubleshooting during offshore anomalies, impacts, or structural damage events.
  • Capture lessons learned from offshore activities and incorporate them into project practices and design standards.

Education

  • BSc or MSc in Civil, Structural, Offshore, or Marine Engineering.
  • Advanced degrees in Offshore Structures or Systems are considered a strong advantage.
  • Extensive relevant experience may compensate for formal education.

Experience

  • Minimum 6 years’ experience in oil & gas, ideally with offshore brownfield or FPSO background.
  • Proven experience with FPSOs, semisubmersibles or topside structures.
  • Experience in structural integrity and reassessment.
  • Experience in life-extension and RBI activities.
  • Experience in offshore inspections and repair campaigns.
  • Experience working with class societies and offshore regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong exposure to project execution and offshore operations, not only design.

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of Offshore steel structures
  • Structural integrity, fatigue, buckling, and yielding
  • Marine and structural interfaces
  • Familiarity with international standards and practices (e.g. ABS, API, ISO, DNV).
  • Experience with structural analysis and FEM tools (e.g. FEMAP/NX, ANSYS, ABAQUS).
  • Solid understanding of offshore inspection methodologies and repair techniques (including composite repairs).

description:
Descrição da vaga

A Globoé feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Dentro da diretoria TV Globo, a pessoa selecionada integrará o time de Marketing de Produto TV Globo e Plataformas Digitais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Planejar, executar e acompanhar ações de marketing online e offline;
  • Planejar o calendário editorial dos produtos;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de conteúdo para gerar conversas públicas;
  • Analisar métricas de desempenho (alcance, engajamento, crescimento, conversão) e elaborar relatórios;
  • Monitorar tendências, comportamento do público;
  • Definir formatos, temas e linhas editoriais para cada plataforma;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as equipes de imprensa, mídia e áreas parceiras;
  • Acompanhar e garantir a execução do planejamento aprovado;
  • Propor melhorias contínuas com base em dados e insights;
  • Apoiar ações de campanhas, lançamentos e ativações digitais.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação Superior Completa em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Comunicação, Jornalismo e áreas parecidas;
  • Experiência em planejamento e conteúdo para redes sociais;
  • Conhecimento das principais plataformas (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise e gestão de redes sociais;
  • Boa capacidade analítica e organização;
  • Excelente comunicação escrita.

Conhecimentos que te destacam:

  • Experiência com planejamento estratégico de conteúdo;
  • Conhecimento em social listening e análise de dados;
  • Vivência com marcas, agências ou ambientes de alta demanda.

Informações adicionais

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.

Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação.

A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles.

Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma 100% remota e nós encorajamos inscrições de qualquer lugar do Brasil e do mundo. #vempraglobo
